raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in Step 8 when it incorrectly stated that "NPR explicitly notes acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)." NPR actually specified acute myeloid leukemia (AML) as the cause of Peter Matthiessen's death, not ALL. This mistake led to a misunderstanding of the cause of death and resulted in a continued, unnecessary focus on resolving ambiguity between AML and ALL in subsequent steps. This misinterpretation impacted the overall efficiency and clarity of the investigation.
